notes: robots.txt checked first: only a generic 'User-agent: *' block (cart/checkout/my-account/api/search/pincode paths) plus a 'Naughty Bots' full-disallow list (CazoodleBot, MJ12bot, dotbot, Gigabot) - NO Claude-specific disallow found, so proceeded normally. Access route: Akamai WAF returns 403 to most desktop curl_cffi TLS fingerprints on ajio.com after a handful of requests (blocks '/', '/s/*' and WebFetch/r.jina.ai/translate.goog alike; robots.txt and the gzip sitemap stayed open throughout), but mobile fingerprints (impersonate='chrome99_android', 'safari17_2_ios') consistently passed even while every desktop profile was blocked - used those for all category-page fetches. Nav tree recovered from window.APP_DATA (a Hybris/SAP Commerce Redux preload) embedded in the SSR home page HTML, at reduxData.content.navigation.items[2].navigation[4] ('HOME & KITCHEN', the top-nav department distinct from Fashion/Beauty/Men/Women/Kids) - scoped strictly to this department's 'CATEGORIES' sub-tree; its sibling 'BRANDS' sub-tree (brand/designer storefront links) was never extracted per the NEVER EXTRACT rule. EXACT qty source: each /s/<slug> listing page is itself SSR-rendered with the live search result already embedded in window.__PRELOADED_STATE__ (pagination.totalResults, matched against 'curatedid' to confirm it's the right node's own result, and cross-checked additive against totalPages*pageSize) - not a marketing widget, this is the same backend total that drives the page's own pagination, and it is never a round number. Excluded whole nav branches outright (unambiguous by name, not individually sampled): Bed Linen, Cushions & Seating, Flooring & Rugs, Curtain and Accessories, Kitchen (cookware/cutlery/bakeware/tools - kitchen appliances explicitly excluded), Stationery & Organisers, Table Linen Sets/Table Covers & Runners/Table Napkins (all textile, under Dining), Festive & Seasonal Decor and Home Gift Sets (Holiday & Gift, under Gifting & Festive), Bath Towel/Robes/Hand & Face Towels/Towel Sets/Bath Curtains & Mats/Bathroom Organisers/Laundry Baskets & Dryers (textile/storage, under Bath), Featured Stories (promotional sale collections). Sampled and dropped entirely (majority out-of-scope, not padded): Home Fragrance (excluded by rule, not sampled - scented candles/diffusers/oils/incense by definition); Plants and Flowers (1093 total, sampled titles overwhelmingly 'Artificial ___ Plant/Flower' - faux plants explicitly excluded); Pooja and Religious Items (119 total, sampled titles are idols/thali sets/devotional statues - religious, treated like Holiday & Gift, matching Myntra Home S.N. 266 precedent of excluding 'Pooja Essentials'); Holders and more (Bath) (90 total, sampled titles are soap/shampoo dispensers, toothbrush holders, toilet-paper holders and a Christmas bathroom set - functional bath fixtures/holiday item, not decorative, matching Myntra's exclusion of functional 'Bathroom Accessories'); Home Essentials (28257 total, sampled titles are sofa covers, storage/organiser boxes, a sensor dustbin, a kitchen shelf - general household mixed rollup, not decor-specific); Bar and Drinkware (6019 total, sampled titles overwhelmingly gym/cycling water bottles and insulated tumblers/thermoses, only incidental glassware - not the decorative/functional glassware scope intends, unlike Myntra where the equivalent node could be filtered down to a pure glass-only facet). Mixed roll-ups kept but flagged null (exact in-scope count unavailable, no site-side filter to split): Wall Shelves (373 total; sampled titles mix genuine wooden wall shelves with wooden Pooja Mandirs/temple stands and a storage box); Lamp, Diyas and Candles (8199 total; mixes decorative lamps/pendant lights that likely overlap with the dedicated Lamps & Lighting node, brass diyas, candle holders (in scope) and explicitly scented jar candles (out of scope) with no filter to isolate any one type); Gardening and Planters (1735 total; mixes genuine planters/terracotta pots (in scope) with artificial/dried flowers and plant stands (out of scope)); Placemats and Coasters (2691 total; roughly even mix of textile placemats (excluded) and decorative coasters (included) with no split filter). Minor-contamination rows kept AS-IS with the site's exact total (contamination is a small minority of sampled titles, not enough to invalidate the site's own named category, and no filter exists to strip it): Wall Decor (44524; ~15% of sampled titles are artificial-floral door hangings/Toran and wallpaper/wall-sticker products, ~85% genuine wall art/showpieces/wall hangings); Chandeliers and Decorative Lights (627; 2 of ~12 sampled titles are plain light bulbs, the rest are genuine chandeliers/pendant/oil-lamp fixtures); Table Lamps (1970; one sampled title is a Pooja Thali set, negligible). Mirrors and Clocks are separate first-level categories per this project's own taxonomy even though AJIO's own nav nests them inside 'HOME DECOR' - this mirrors how Myntra Home (S.N. 266) was structured, for cross-company consistency. Status is 'partial' (not 'ok') because 4 of 18 leaf rows (Wall Shelves, Lamp Diyas and Candles, Gardening and Planters, Placemats and Coasters) are null+flagged.
